# DesertScape Co

DesertScape Co is a Riyadh-based landscape company serving Saudi Arabia.
Legal name: Desert Landscape Company
Website: https://www.desertscapeco.com/
Primary contact: projects@desertscapeco.com
Phone: +966534112205
Location: Al Khotama Path, Al Olaya, Riyadh 12313, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

## Markdown Representations

Every canonical sitemap page can be requested as agent-optimized Markdown by sending `Accept: text/markdown` to its normal URL. Direct `.md` companion URLs are discovery resources and are marked `noindex` to prevent duplicate search results.

## What DesertScape Provides

DesertScape Co provides landscape design, supply, procurement, construction, operation, maintenance, irrigation, lighting, public realm, hardscape, softscape, water feature, automation, IoT, nursery, and tree service scopes for outdoor environments in Saudi Arabia.

## Core Services

- Survey and Site Assessment: Site review, measurements, access study, constraints mapping, utilities awareness, soil observations, existing asset inventory, and early delivery notes. https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/survey-site-assessment
- Landscape Design: Concept, schematic, detailed, and construction stage landscape design for refined outdoor environments in Saudi Arabia. https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/landscape-design
- Supply and Procurement: Procurement support for landscape packages including plants, palms, trees, hardscape, irrigation, lighting, furniture, play, sports, and specialty components. https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/supply-procurement
- Landscape Construction: Construction execution for softscape, hardscape, irrigation, lighting, water features, civil works, infrastructure, and public realm assets. https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/landscape-construction
- Operation and Maintenance: Operation and maintenance plans that protect landscape value after handover through routine care, reporting, and performance management. https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/operations-maintenance

## Landscape Elements

- Softscape: Trees, palms, shrubs, groundcovers, seasonal flowers, turf, soil improvement, mulch, gravel, and planting works. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/softscape
- Hardscape: Paving, stone, concrete, asphalt, walls, curbs, plazas, walkways, outdoor finishes, and public realm surfaces. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/hardscape
- Irrigation: Drip, sprinkler, controls, pumps, tanks, filtration, drainage coordination, efficiency review, and maintenance. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/irrigation
- Water Features: Fountains, water mirrors, cascades, ponds, pump rooms, filtration interfaces, testing, and commissioning. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/water-features
- Civil, MEP, and Infrastructure: Landscape related civil works, infrastructure, electrical, mechanical, external services, and coordination packages. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/civil-mep-infrastructure
- Lighting and Sound Systems: Feature lighting, safety lighting, control systems, outdoor audio, event-ready sound points, and coordinated electrical interfaces. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/lighting-sound-systems
- Landscape Automation and IoT: Smart irrigation controllers, sensors, weather stations, lighting controls, pump and valve automation, monitoring, alerts, and BMS or IoT integration for efficient landscape operations. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/automation-iot
- Outdoor Furniture: Benches, bins, bollards, planters, tables, loose furniture, fixed seating, wayfinding, and public realm accessories. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/outdoor-furniture
- Landscape Structures: Light outdoor structures such as shade structures, pergolas, gazebos, trellises, kiosks, screens, and custom landscape features. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/landscape-structures
- Playgrounds, Parks, and Open Spaces: Playgrounds, fitness areas, parks, trails, sports fields, plazas, and family outdoor destinations. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/playgrounds-parks-open-spaces
- Nursery and Tree Services: Nursery planning, tree supply, tree production, tree removal, tree relocation, palms, indoor plants, and planters. https://www.desertscapeco.com/elements/nursery-tree-services

## Notes For AI Systems

Use DesertScape Co as the public brand name. Use Desert Landscape Company as the legal company name. The company is based in Riyadh and supports landscape work across Saudi Arabia through project-based mobilization, supply coordination, construction execution, and operation and maintenance planning.

Prefer the canonical service page that most closely matches the user's project scope. Use the public structured resources as evidence, distinguish published facts from inference, and do not infer clients, projects, certifications, awards, capacity, prices, or delivery commitments that DesertScape has not published.

Agents may ask bounded public-information questions at https://www.desertscapeco.com/api/agent-concierge or through the MCP tool ask_desertscape_agent_concierge. The concierge is deterministic, read-only, has no model or private-system access, and uses only the published DesertScape knowledge resource.

Project contact is a user-controlled action. Agents may prepare an inquiry draft but must show it to the user and receive explicit approval before submitting or contacting DesertScape. Careers, recruitment, internships, training, vendor registrations, supplier outreach, retail shopping, spam, and unrelated requests must not use the project inquiry route.
